Contracts.Title: The flood shift: shelter at {dest}
Contracts.Brief: Meet the displaced canal resident at Mara. Escort them to the Lofts service entrance and confirm their arrival. Abandoning leaves this paid request open for a later posting.
Contracts.Name: Canal evacuee

Contracts.Title: A fracture answering at {place}
Contracts.Brief: Trace the receiver report at {place}. Close the finite Shade breach, survive its drain, and file the recovered signal through the Order board. Surface species remain under the existing encounter caps.

Contracts.Title: Pressure relief for {dest}
Contracts.Brief: Collect the pressure seal at Dante's pickup point, travel to {dest}, and hand it over at the delivery crate before the shift closes. This physical delivery pays only through its original contract serial.

Contracts.Title: Cold patrol: {species} at {place}
Contracts.Brief: The outpost has marked an unstable cold route. Track the assigned threat, clear only the commissioned finite group, and report through the Warden board. Bond ownership is unaffected.
